item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02995","case1_error":"Correct profit formula is followed by unsupported $88; the formula yields $98.","case2_error":"Correct monthly earnings formulas and summation are followed by unsupported $1,350; they yield $1,200.","reason":"Both provide correct formulas but append incorrect final numbers without showing the calculation producing them.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02996","case1_error":"Treats the 12 additional green apples as the entire green count, omitting the baseline 16 green apples.","case2_error":"Assumes four four-month periods per year instead of three.","reason":"One confuses an additive difference with a total count; the other uses an incorrect time conversion factor.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02997","case1_error":"Constructs invalid population ratios, deriving 9.5 moose per human instead of 1/38.","case2_error":"Counts five family members instead of four, dividing the correct strawberry total by the wrong number of recipients.","reason":"The first incorrectly constructs and combines ratios; the second miscounts people in an equal division.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02998","case1_error":"Uses Jack's current apples divided by Jack's capacity, 8/12, instead of Jill's capacity divided by Jack's apples, 24/8.","case2_error":"Converts an already-ounce subtotal as though it were pounds, then reverses the roles of total fruit and non-peach fruit.","reason":"The first selects the wrong comparison ratio; the second mishandles units and exchanges total and subtotal roles.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02999","case1_error":"Equates the brother's entire pre-purchase balance with Michael's gift, then answers Michael's supposed starting money instead of the brother's.","case2_error":"Invents four additional working hours, then divides hypothetical blocks by truck capacity mislabeled as an hourly rate.","reason":"The first conflates a balance with a transfer and changes the requested person; the second invents duration and uses capacity as rate.","judgment":"different"}]}
